subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north. Only five people sit between A and F. G sits third to the left of F. E is the immediate neighbour of B and F. C is not the immediate neighbour of G.

How many people sit between C and E?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only five people sit between A and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25e60454a7e395c15069fd38436d0e37c2c071c50fe776cd100d0a87f88d3840.png] 

G sits third to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e27aaa1d3a0a416304537e5a594802af45deda0228af35aae5dc4112ffc1ac9.png] 

E is the immediate neighbour of B and F. C is not the immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35cd2688514fc61093eeb82b5512e557bacd2a2dae6ba126c440770c6f9ce16b.png] 

Final arrangement,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccfae690f9a09d036cec2b802d14617aef16484b12b28d8e281c56939e610adb.png] 

Thus, The only three people sit between C and E.</p&g
t;

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
